about.heading: From interfaces to the systems behind them
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer with 4+ years of professional software development experience across frontend and backend, with 2+ years focused on backend and full-stack engineering using C#, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, and REST APIs. I also have 3.5+ years of frontend development experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.

I started with frontend development and expanded into backend engineering, databases, API design, authentication, authorization, transactions, and application architecture. My recent work is primarily focused on .NET backend development while continuing to contribute across the frontend when required.
I care about maintainable software, clear architecture, predictable APIs, well-designed data models, reusable components, and practical engineering decisions without unnecessary complexity.

exploring.label: Currently exploring
exploring.description: Currently strengthening my experience with Dapper, Docker, and Azure while continuing to improve backend engineering, testing, and production deployment skills.

items.description: Work primarily on backend and full-stack development using C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, REST APIs, Clean Architecture, JWT authentication, and role-based authorization, while contributing to frontend development with React and Next.js.
Developed responsive client-facing web applications and websites using React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend tools, with experience across WordPress and Webflow projects.

Gained hands-on experience in full-stack application development using C#, ASP.NET Core, React, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, and ADO.NET, including APIs, database-backed features, and frontend development.
Developed responsive web interfaces and email templates using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap while working with design and marketing requirements.
Developed responsive web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap, including implementation of design specifications and responsive layouts.

items.title: Datanex
items.description: An enterprise work management platform developed for a confidential client based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. The platform manages projects, sites, work activities, progress tracking, images, user access, and document-related metadata.
items.problem: The platform provides structured management of projects, sites, and operational work, including progress records, supporting images, access control, and document metadata tracking.

details.notes: The backend is primarily developed by Kamran as part of a team. Specific business workflows and client data are confidential and cannot be disclosed.

items.title: HRMS
items.description: An HRMS product currently under development for internal use and planned commercial use with schools. The project is currently in its foundational phase.
items.problem: Building a practical HR management platform for schools and internal company use, starting with a focused first phase and a maintainable backend foundation.

details.notes: Currently in the early development phase with project setup and initial domain/entity work completed. Dapper is planned for later development and is not represented as an already implemented feature.

items.title: Harmain Services
items.description: A live multi-service marketplace platform developed as part of CODE3 project work, connecting customers with service providers and handling service requests, provider notifications, and first-come-first-served job assignment through WhatsApp.
items.problem: Customers need a simple way to discover and request services while service operations require reliable data handling, communication, and status updates across multiple service categories.

details.notes: Primarily contributed to backend development as part of the CODE3 team. When a customer creates a service request, eligible providers are notified through WhatsApp; the first provider to accept receives the job while other providers are notified that it has been accepted.
